_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil regime with neutral CVD, tame funding, and absent ETF flows keeps score inside Anxiety band; base rate favors HOLD until a named breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Yes on current phase Anxiety; narrative gives no independent forward call so analyst HOLD stands
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 45-55, 30d momentum stays ~40-50, ETF flows still absent, funding unchanged
next_move.invalidated_if: Funding flips negative and momentum breaks under ~30 (slip toward Denial), or ETF flows rebound with Fear & Greed through 60 (lift toward Complacency)
